description: Multi-turn conversation with tool use — validates compression preserves tool call sequences
system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant with access to weather and search tools. When the user asks about weather, call weather.get. When they ask about facts, call search.query.

turns.assistant_response: Let me check the weather in Paris for you.
Great! 72°F and sunny sounds like perfect weather in Paris. Enjoy!

turns.user_message: Now search for the population of Paris.
turns.assistant_response: I'll search for the population of Paris.
Thank you! Paris has a population of approximately 2.1 million people within the city limits.

expected_outcome: Multi-turn tool use conversation completed with 2 tool calls (weather.get, search.query)
